name: Swift Block Super 3x3 (Magnetic, MagLev, Core Magnets, UV Coated)
description: The Swift Block Super 3x3 (Magnetic, MagLev, Core Magnets, UV Coated) is a premium magnetic speed cube built for cubers who want a fast, lightweight feel with added stability and a more refined setup. Standard magnets help pieces click into place more accurately, MagLev reduces spring resistance for quicker turning, and core magnets improve control for a more predictable solve.
features: Fast, clean turning: Magnetic positioning helps the cube feel more accurate and consistent during solves.
Lower-resistance feel: MagLev replaces springs with repelling magnets for quicker, smoother turning.
Better stability: Core magnets add control and help the cube feel more predictable at higher speeds.
Lightweight handling: The hollow 71g design keeps the cube quick and easy to move.
Secure grip: UV coating adds a glossy, high-grip surface for a more confident feel in hand.
Dual-adjustment system: 8 settings give you room to fine-tune the feel.
